title: input stances (schema 1)
description: data/input/stances.json: the hybrid stance masks that are switched on (docs/controls/lunge-control.md A2, sim/input/stance.gd). The mask is LB 1, RB 2, RT 4, LT 8. Until a mask is listed, a held pair reads as its newer button. RT (4) dominates and is never part of a hybrid. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

hybrids.description: 3 is LB+RB (defensive ki), 9 is LT+LB (terrain while flying), 10 is LT+RB (evasive energy).
